name: github-trending
description: Fetch trending GitHub repositories across multiple languages in parallel

steps.name: fetch-python-trending
steps.prompt:
Fetch trending Python repositories from GitHub using the API:

URL: https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=language:python+created:>{date_7_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5

Note: Calculate the date 7 days ago from today (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

Extract for each repo:
- Name and full_name
- Description (truncate if too long)
- Star count
- URL

Return formatted list.

steps.name: fetch-javascript-trending
steps.prompt:
Fetch trending JavaScript/TypeScript repositories from GitHub:

URLs to try (fetch both if possible):
1. https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=language:javascript+created:>{date_7_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5
2. https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=language:typescript+created:>{date_7_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5

Extract for each repo:
- Name and description
- Star count
- URL

Return combined formatted list for both languages.

steps.name: fetch-rust-go-trending
steps.prompt:
Fetch trending Rust and Go repositories from GitHub:

URLs:
1. Rust: https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=language:rust+created:>{date_7_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5
2. Go: https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=language:go+created:>{date_7_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5

Extract for each:
- Name, description, stars, URL

Return formatted list combining both languages.

steps.name: fetch-hacker-news-top
steps.prompt:
Fetch top stories from Hacker News using the API:

Step 1: Get top story IDs from https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json
Step 2: Fetch details for the first 10 story IDs from https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/{id}.json

Extract for each story:
- Title
- URL
- Score (upvotes)
- Comment count

Return as formatted list with 🔥 emojis for highly upvoted (>100) stories.

steps.name: format-tech-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Tech Trending Digest for Discord.

**Python Trending:**
{{trending_python}}

**JavaScript/TypeScript Trending:**
{{trending_js}}

**Rust & Go Trending:**
{{trending_system}}

**Hacker News Top:**
{{hn_stories}}

FORMAT:
```
🚀 **GitHub Trending & HN Top — {date}**

**🐍 Python Trending**
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)

**⚡ JavaScript/TypeScript**
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)

**⚙️ Rust & Go**
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)
• repo-name — description (⭐ XX stars)

**🔥 Hacker News Top**
• Story title (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)
• Story title (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)
• Story title (🔼 XXX pts)
• Story title (🔼 XXX pts)

_OpenFang Tech Pulse — Live GitHub & HN Data_
```

Focus on the most interesting/valuable repos and stories. Keep under 2000 characters.
